checkpoint_screening.primary_selection_metric: micro AP50, with overall F1 and scale recall as supporting metrics

final_threshold_policy: One threshold per selected baseline was optimized for micro F1 on the complete 548-image validation split and is now frozen for test-dev. AP50 remains threshold-free.

evaluation.ignored_region_rule: Drop GT and detections with at least 50% box area covered by the union of VisDrone category-0 ignored regions; retain score-0 target GT as ignored matches.
evaluation.ap50: 101-point interpolated, both macro across six categories and micro across all target instances
